name: AXM Evidence Chain Candidate Review Gate
actions: bind a broken source, its inspection receipt, a recovery candidate, and its recovery receipt
verify non-hash semantics, hashes, transitions, and receipt bindings
record one fixed review decision without granting application authority
download digest-only assessment and decision receipts
summary: Independently checks an exact evidence-chain recovery bundle and records a bounded review decision that cannot apply or authorize the candidate.
notes: Review-only and explicit-download-only. A PASS means the structural bundle is internally consistent, not that content is authentic or history is restored. Decisions never apply candidates, recover sessions, grant authority, promote, or change CANON.
